paragraphs.text: Damon Orthodontics is a third-generation, Spokane-rooted practice that invented the globally used Damon System and delivers personalized, airway-focused orthodontic care using state-of-the-art technology. With over 50 years of family experience, we emphasize faster, more comfortable treatment and face-driven smile design.

We serve families across Spokane with flexible payment options, multiple neighborhood locations, and a team committed to clear communication and long-term results. Whether you want Damon self-ligating braces, clear aligners, or airway-focused care, we make the process straightforward and welcoming.

items.text: Inventors of the Damon System, our family legacy brings deep technical expertise and decades of clinical refinement.

image.alt: Damon Orthodontics team smiling in a bright clinic

paragraphs.text: At Damon Orthodontics, Damon braces offer efficient, comfortable tooth movement tailored to each patient. Your first visit is a free consultation where you’ll meet our team, receive an exam, and learn whether Damon braces or another option is the right fit.

We welcome patients with no referral required and provide flexible monthly payments to make treatment manageable. During your visit we’ll review your medical history, take any needed images, and discuss a personalized treatment plan.

image.alt: Family at reception with smiling staff

paragraphs.text: The Damon approach combines high-quality technology with lighter, gentler tooth movement and airway-focused care. That can mean faster, more comfortable treatment and a broader, fuller smile.
Our clinical experience emphasizes predictable results and long-term stability, helping patients achieve lasting, healthy smiles with care that fits their life and budget.

Invented here in Spokane and refined over 50 years, the Damon System uses advanced bracket design and modern treatment planning to reduce friction and improve comfort. Dr. Clay Damon and our team personalize every plan to deliver efficient, evidence-informed care.

image.alt: Smiling patients of all ages at Lakeshore Orthodontics

paragraphs.text: Damon Braces use a self‑ligating bracket system that lets teeth move with lighter, gentler forces. That often shortens treatment and reduces the number of adjustment visits, making care easier to fit into a busy life.
Self‑ligating brackets hold the wire in a sliding mechanism instead of elastic ties. This reduces friction so teeth can move more freely and comfortably.

image.alt: Young patient receiving early orthodontic intervention

paragraphs.text: Because the system reduces friction, appointments are often shorter and less frequent. Many patients describe adjustments as noticeably gentler.

image.alt: Teen patient smiling with braces

paragraphs.text: Damon Braces treat a wide range of alignment and bite issues. We’ll recommend the best appliance after a complimentary exam and digital evaluation.

image.alt: Adult patient receiving orthodontic treatment
Smiling family enjoying time together

paragraphs.text: Damon Clear delivers the low‑friction benefits of the Damon System in a tooth‑colored ceramic bracket, giving adults a more discreet option without sacrificing efficiency.

image.alt: Smiling Woman with Clear Aligner

paragraphs.text: Ceramic brackets are designed to resist staining when cared for properly. We’ll review cleaning tips and dietary guidance to keep your braces discreet.

image.alt: Two stylish smiling teens taking selfie with braces
Two stylish smiling teens taking selfie with braces

paragraphs.text: Traditional metal braces remain a reliable option for a wide range of alignment and bite issues. Metal brackets and wires are durable and effective, especially for cases that require significant tooth movement.

While metal braces are visible, they offer predictable results and tend to fit a broad range of treatment needs. We’ll review maintenance, appointment cadence, and dietary adjustments at your first visit.

image.alt: Dental Checkup with Braces

paragraphs.text: Self‑ligating braces use brackets with an internal sliding mechanism instead of elastic ties. That reduces friction and can allow teeth to move more efficiently with lighter forces.
Many patients experience fewer adjustment appointments and improved comfort. We’ll evaluate whether a self‑ligating system or another appliance best fits your specific goals.

image.alt: Two stylish smiling teens taking selfie with braces

paragraphs.text: Invisalign<sup>®</sup> uses a series of custom, removable clear aligners to move teeth gradually. Advanced 3D scanning and treatment planning help create a precise fit, letting many patients straighten teeth without brackets and wires.
Because aligners are removable, they make brushing, flossing, and eating easier. We’ll review expectations, wearing schedules, and monitoring so you know what to expect at each stage.

image.alt: Close-up of Invisalign aligners being placed on teeth

paragraphs.text: Spark Clear Aligners offer a nearly invisible, removable option made from advanced materials and high‑resolution manufacturing. They’re designed for comfort and efficient tooth movement in appropriate cases.
High‑resolution scans and precise manufacturing help Spark aligners fit snugly and deliver predictable force where it’s needed.

image.alt: iTero digital scanner in use during orthodontic consultation

paragraphs.text: Remote monitoring tools let us check aligner progress between visits, reducing unnecessary trips while keeping treatment on track.

image.alt: Digital X-ray equipment showing detailed orthodontic imaging

paragraphs.text: Clear aligners work well for many adults and teens. Eligibility depends on case complexity; we’ll discuss options after a full exam and digital scan.

image.alt: 3D treatment planning software showing orthodontic simulation
Modern dentist office interior with advanced technology

paragraphs.text: For severe skeletal discrepancies, we coordinate orthodontic and surgical care to correct jaw alignment and restore function. Surgery is planned closely with oral and maxillofacial surgeons for predictable outcomes.
Care includes comprehensive planning with digital imaging, a clear timeline, and post‑surgical orthodontic follow‑up to refine bite and stability.

image.alt: Orthodontic patient receiving orthognathic surgical consultation

paragraphs.text: Orthodontic care can play a role in airway health. Oral appliances and careful orthodontic planning may help improve airway space for some patients, but sleep apnea diagnosis and treatment require collaboration with medical specialists.

image.alt: Modern dentist office interior with advanced technology

accordion.header: What orthodontic treatments do you offer?

paragraphs.text: We provide traditional metal braces, Damon self-ligating braces including Damon Clear, and clear aligners such as Invisalign<sup>®</sup>. Each treatment is customized to your needs; the Damon System often uses lighter forces and can shorten treatment time in many cases.

image.alt: Happy Family Portrait

accordion.header: At what age should my child see an orthodontist?

paragraphs.text: The American Association of Orthodontists recommends an evaluation by age 7. Early visits let us monitor jaw and tooth development and plan treatment that may reduce the need for more extensive procedures later.

image.alt: Couple Enjoying Time Together

accordion.header: How long does treatment usually take?

paragraphs.text: Treatment time depends on the issue and chosen appliance. Many patients complete care within 12 to 24 months; the Damon System frequently shortens that to about 12–18 months. We’ll give you a personalized timeline at your first appointment.

image.alt: Collaborative Team Spirit Moment

accordion.header: What payment and insurance options are available?

paragraphs.text: We offer flexible monthly payment plans and accept most major dental insurance carriers. Our team will review your coverage and help arrange financing so treatment fits your budget.

image.alt: Smiling Man Working at Desk

paragraphs.text: Call our office at (509) 448-2600 or request a free consultation online at https://damon-orthodontics.com/free-consult/. We’ll help you find a convenient appointment time.
